items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: He has performed and recorded with a diverse roster of jazz luminaries including John Coltrane, Herbie Hancock, and Bill Evans.

ctx.x: Bassist and composer Chuck Israels was born in New York City on August 10, 1936. He has performed and recorded with a diverse roster of jazz luminaries including John Coltrane, Herbie Hancock, and Bill Evans. Chuck directed the National Jazz Ensemble from 1973 to 1981 and he currently directs a jazz nonet in Portland, Oregon.
Chuck was interviewed via Zoom on June 11, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
